title: CRISPR screens identify PRMT7 as a therapeutic target to enhance T cell-mediated killing in breast cancer
model: MCF7 breast cancer cells, custom breast-cancer risk-gene CRISPRko and CRISPRi libraries, cytotoxic-T-cell co-culture
contrast: Day 11 + T cells vs day 11 no T cells, replicate-paired (3 vs 3), KO and CRISPRi arms
paper_method: MAGeCK-MLE (Common, IFN, Tcell terms); 33 final genes (20 resistors, 13 sensitizers) after fitness filtering, 88 at Tcell FDR 0.2
paper_calls: 33 modulators; validated IRF1, ATF7IP, CASP8 (resistors) and CFLAR, CREBBP, PRMT7 (sensitizers); PRMT7 lead target
barcs_calls: KO: 88 genes at FDR 0.10 (105 vs control null); CRISPRi: 175 (184 vs control null); counts recovered exactly from MAGeCK-normalized tables
named_hits: Positive controls IFNGR1/IFNGR2 #1-2 in both arms; all 6 validated genes called in at least one arm (CFLAR, IRF1 both; CASP8, CREBBP in KO; PRMT7, ATF7IP in CRISPRi)
verdict: The positive controls (IFNGR1/2, JAK1/2, HLA-A, TAP1, CD58) top both arms and all six validated genes are BARCS calls in at least one arm, matching the paper's own pooled-evidence pattern; BARCS's single D11+T vs D11 contrast calls more genes than the paper's 33 because it cannot subtract fitness effects the way the paper's MLE Common term does.
